name: The Test Cabinet
postCreateCommand: sudo chown "$(id -u):$(id -g)" /cargo-target && (bash scripts/setup-hooks.sh || echo 'setup-hooks failed; run scripts/setup-hooks.sh manually') && (bash scripts/ci/install-purescript.sh || echo 'install-purescript failed; gg’s PureScript tests need it — run scripts/ci/install-purescript.sh manually') && (bash scripts/ci/install-kotlin.sh || echo 'install-kotlin failed; gg’s Java and Kotlin tests need it — run scripts/ci/install-kotlin.sh manually')
postStartCommand: bash .devcontainer/tools/docker-socket-access.sh || true; if [ -S /tmp/ssh-agent.sock ]; then rm -f /tmp/devcontainer-ssh-agent.sock && (sudo socat UNIX-LISTEN:/tmp/devcontainer-ssh-agent.sock,fork,mode=0666 UNIX-CONNECT:/tmp/ssh-agent.sock >/tmp/ssh-agent-socat.log 2>&1 &); fi
